title: Ken Johnston told to destroy anomalous Apollo negatives

tellings.quote: was told to destroy a bunch of like first generation or early generation Apollo negatives uh because they had some anomalies on them and they're not supposed to be there and they don't want to release them publicly and he actually saved some of them

plain: A NASA worker named Ken Johnston Sr. was told to destroy a batch of early photo negatives from the Apollo moon missions because they showed things "not supposed to be there", and he quietly saved some of them. The physicist Maaneli Derakhshani passes this on from what Johnston said, adding that NASA did not want the images released. If true, it would mean the space agency hid strange things in its own moon photos.
